info.title: LakeSpeak.Cli
info.description: Interactive and scriptable terminal client for Databricks Genie Agents. Ask questions, inspect generated SQL, export results, and run version-controlled Question Packs. Independent open-source project, not affiliated with Databricks.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
LakeSpeak.NET — talk to governed Databricks data from your terminal.
An independent open-source project, not affiliated with Databricks.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Databricks CLI profile to authenticate with.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, table, markdown, json, jsonl, csv. [default: text]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress progress output on stderr. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print diagnostic detail to stderr. Credentials are always redacted. [default: False]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the Genie Agents this identity can see.

commands.name: ask
commands.description: Ask a question and print the answer.

options.name: --agent
options.description: Agent id, title, or a configured alias.

options.name: --show-sql
options.description: Print the generated SQL alongside the answer. [default: False]

commands.name: chat
commands.description: Hold a stateful conversation with a Genie Agent.

options.name: --agent
options.description: Agent id, title, or a configured alias.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Verify that credentials and the workspace host resolve.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the effective configuration and where each value came from.

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Run repeatable, version-controlled sets of questions.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Check a Question Pack without running it.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the Question Pack YAML file.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a Question Pack and write its report.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report here instead of the pack's configured path.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the Question Pack YAML file.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the Question Pack YAML file.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export the last query result without opening a chat session.

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write. Defaults to stdout.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the output file if it exists. [default: False]

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Which result to export. Currently only 'last'. [default: last]

commands.name: feedback
commands.description: Rate the last answer, without opening a chat session.

options.name: --comment
options.description: Optional free-text comment sent to Databricks.

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Which answer to rate. Currently only 'last'. [default: last]
